name: claw-mem
description: Local-First Three-Tier Memory System for OpenClaw (TypeScript)

scripts.build: tsc && cp openclaw.plugin.json dist/ && mkdir -p dist/src && cp openclaw.plugin.json dist/src/ && mkdir -p dist/claw_mem_plugin && cp openclaw.plugin.json dist/claw_mem_plugin/ && cd claw_mem_plugin && npm run build && cp dist/index.js ../dist/ && cp dist/index.d.ts ../dist/ 2>/dev/null; echo 'plugin built'

author: Peter Cheng
